What does an actor actually need from a smartphone when every day involves switching between different roles, tasks and interests?

In this conversation, Ria shares what life looks like beyond the characters she plays, from carrying only the essentials to preparing for roles, researching references, scrolling through social media, watching movies and capturing spontaneous moments.

At the centre of that everyday routine is the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8, which moves between a compact folded form and an expansive inner display while supporting the different ways she uses her phone throughout the day.

From its slim, pocketable design and Multi Window multitasking to the Cover Screen, expansive inner display and 50MP high-resolution camera, the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 is showcased as a device that can adapt to different moments throughout the day.

Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8: Slim and pocketable

Ria describes herself as someone who prefers carrying very little. Her everyday essentials include her phone, keys and sunglasses.

That is where the design of the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 comes into the conversation. Its compact folded form is highlighted for its portability, with the phone easily slipping into a pocket.

The video specifically focuses on the new design, slim form factor and pocketable nature of the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8, showing how the device can stay compact while being ready to open up when more screen space is needed.

Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 for multitasking

Preparing for an acting role can involve several things happening at once.

Ria talks about reading scripts, looking up references, making notes, researching topics and responding to messages, often switching between different tasks simultaneously.

The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 is shown open in a work setup using Multi Window, allowing her to move between her script, references, research and notes across two apps.

This use case highlights one of the core experiences demonstrated in the video: using the larger foldable display to manage multiple types of information and tasks within the same workflow.

Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Cover Screen

Not every smartphone interaction requires the phone to be fully unfolded.

The video shows Ria using the Cover Screen while browsing Instagram and Pinterest. What starts as looking for a single reference can quickly turn into saving ideas for clothes, interiors and travel.

The Cover Screen therefore becomes part of the everyday browsing experience, allowing quick interactions while the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 remains folded.

Watch the full conversation to see how the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 fits into an actor’s busy, creative and constantly changing day.
